read.en: AAOI rose 0.8% on Oct 21 to $77.32, trading between $76.51 and $81.20. It is below its falling 5-day ($78.3), 10-day ($89.2), 30-day ($100.2) and 100-day ($122.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($112.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($108.68), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: AAOI 10月21日上涨 0.8%，收于 $77.32，盘中区间 $76.51–81.20。股价位于下行的 5 日（$78.3）、10 日（$89.2）、30 日（$100.2）和 100 日均线（$122.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$112.8）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$108.68），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The high reached $81.2 but the close slipped back under the 5-day average; the low held the $76 Jul 29 support. Resistance is $78.3–78.6 (5-day, Mar 31 low), then $81.2 (Oct 21 high) and $84.6–85. Support is $76, then $73.05 (Oct 20 low) and $65.6. A close above $81.2 would target $85; a close below $73 would open $65.6.
read.zh: 盘中高点触及 $81.2，但收盘回落至 5 日均线下方；低点守住 $76 的 7月29日支撑。阻力为 $78.3–78.6（5 日均线、3月31日低点），其次 $81.2（10月21日高点）和 $84.6–85。支撑为 $76，其次 $73.05（10月20日低点）和 $65.6。若收盘站上 $81.2，下一目标看 $85；若收盘跌破 $73，将打开 $65.6。
